{{Quote|Welcome to our village. You've earned the right to be here&mdash;more than those stooges Moff Yurrion pays us to protect.|Randar Mohl, to the Imperial individual|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Randor Mohl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] chieftain who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual came to [[Outpost Rennar]] with the remains fallen Mandalorian initiates, and brought the dead to Mohl.<ref name="TOR" />
